title: Verify paginated outcome discovery
preconditions: A completed evaluation has suggestion, no_suggestion, conflict, and stale-capable rows plus active category and rule evidence in an isolated data root.
steps: Invoke the published schema and Native-AOT classify.outcome.list boundary for empty, one-page, and multi-page evaluations; apply every supported filter; walk every continuation; pass returned outcome IDs unchanged to selected_outcomes preview.
expected: Pages are ordered by ordinal then transaction ID; totals and fields are exact; every row appears once; filters compose with AND semantics; list-to-preview composition needs no per-outcome process and performs zero Ledger mutation.
cleanup: Remove only the isolated data root.
